cases.sentence: Люди обманывают. Воры пробираются в дома, разбойники грабят на ___.
cases.translation: People deceive. Thieves break into houses; robbers rob on the streets.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case when indicating location.

cases.sentence: Но они не осознают, что я помню все их злые ___.
cases.translation: But they don't realize that I remember all their evil deeds.
cases.explain: The transitive verb помню (I remember) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Они веселят царя своим ___, вождей своей ложью.
cases.translation: They make the king glad with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.
cases.explain: The verb веселят (make glad) takes the instrumental case to indicate means.

cases.sentence: Все они — распутники, пылают словно печь, чей огонь не нужно поддерживать ___.
cases.translation: They are all adulterers. They burn like an oven whose fire doesn't need tending by the baker.
cases.explain: The dative case is used with impersonal expressions indicating necessity.

cases.sentence: В день праздника нашего царя вожди напиваются ___ до бесчувствия.
cases.translation: On the day of our king's festival, the princes became drunk with wine to the point of unconsciousness.
cases.explain: The verb напиваются (become drunk) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Все они раскалены, как печь, истребляют своих же ___.
cases.translation: They are all hot as an oven; they devour their judges.
cases.explain: The transitive verb истребляют (devour) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ефрем смешался с нечестивыми ___, уподобился хлебу, недопеченному.
cases.translation: Ephraim mixes himself with wicked peoples, has become like bread half-baked.
cases.explain: The verb смешался (mixed) with 'с' followed by genitive for group membership.

cases.sentence: Чужестранцы поедают его силы, а он и не осознает ___.
cases.translation: Strangers consume his strength, but he doesn't realize it.
cases.explain: The transitive verb осознает (realizes) governs the accusative case.

reading.ru: Когда я исцелю Израиль, откроются грехи Ефрема, и преступления столицы Самарии будут разоблачены.
reading.question: What will be revealed when God heals Israel?
options: The sins of Ephraim and crimes of Samaria
reading.correct: The sins of Ephraim and crimes of Samaria
reading.explain: The text states that when God heals Israel, the sins of Ephraim and the crimes of Samaria will be exposed.

reading.ru: Люди обманывают. Воры пробираются в дома, разбойники грабят на улицах.
reading.question: What crimes are described in this verse?
reading.explain: The verse explicitly mentions people deceiving, thieves breaking in, and robbers raiding in the streets.

reading.ru: Они веселят царя своим злодейством, вождей своей ложью.
reading.question: With what do they please the king and princes?
reading.explain: The text says they make the king glad with their wickedness and the princes with their lies.

reading.ru: Все они — распутники, пылают словно печь, чей огонь не нужно поддерживать спекарю с момента замешивания теста и до тех пор, пока оно не поднимется.
reading.question: To what is their passion compared?
options: An oven that burns without needing the baker to stoke it
A raging fire on a mountain
A lightning bolt in a storm
The heat of the sun at noon
reading.correct: An oven that burns without needing the baker to stoke it
reading.explain: Their passion is likened to an oven that burns without the baker needing to tend it from the kneading of dough until it rises.

reading.ru: Ефрем смешался с нечестивыми народами, уподобился хлебу, недопеченному с одной стороны и подгоревшему с другой.
reading.question: What is Ephraim's condition compared to?
options: Bread half-baked on one side and burned on the other
A rotten tree bearing no fruit
A broken vessel that cannot hold water
reading.correct: Bread half-baked on one side and burned on the other
reading.explain: Ephraim is compared to bread that is underbaked on one side and burned on the other, indicating his ruined and corrupted state.

reading.ru: Гордость Израиля свидетельствует против него, но при всем этом он не возвращается к Господу, своему Богу, и не ищет его.
reading.question: Despite what testifying against him, what does Israel still not do?
options: Return to God and seek Him
reading.correct: Return to God and seek Him
reading.explain: Despite Israel's pride testifying against him, he does not return to Yahweh his God, nor seek him.
